Quick: name the best-selling video game of all time. Three, two, one.
It's Minecraft. Now guess how many copies it sold. Comment your number.
Hint: the full game came out fifteen years ago this week.
By launch day, it had already sold four million copies.

text: Last year, Guinness confirmed three hundred fifty million.
And in September, Xbox's boss posted: more than four hundred twenty-five million.

That's over a hundred times its launch sales.
And three hundred thousand people play it for the first time every single day.

text: That's more than three new players every second. Over a hundred started while you watched this.
